title: run IDs: retry with a new suffix when the run directory already exists, and widen the 2-byte random suffix

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
S631's round-1 full suite (run ork-20261127-194833-6309, slice-checks-1-11.log) failed once with:
"--- FAIL: TestWaveHeldMemberStartsAfterTheEarlierLands ... item failed: run ork-20261127-205645-9e55: mkdir .../runs/ork-20261127-205645-9e55: file exists".
The test passes 8 of 8 times on main and in the worktree, so it is a collision, not a logic failure. Run IDs are "ork-" + time to the second + Deps.randHex(), which is 2 random bytes (internal/engine/engine.go:117-124, :428). Two runs created in the same second (or under a fixed test clock) collide with probability about 1/65536 per pair, and the mkdir then fails the run. The red slice check then stuck through rounds 2 and 3 because the product did not change, and the orchestrator had to retry by hand.

Make run creation retry with a fresh suffix when the directory exists, and use more random bytes; chain- and wave- IDs (internal/daemon/runs.go:1378, :1675) have the same shape.
